entries: When the vila sings, all those within 60 feet of her and who can hear her must make a successful {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition stunned} for {@dice 1d4} rounds. Those who succeed on the saving throw are immune to that vila's singing for 24 hours.

action.name: Forest Song (1/Day)
entries: The vila magically calls {@dice 2d6} wolves or 2 wampus cats. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the vila and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vila dies, or until the vila dismisses them as a bonus action.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The vila's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Forest's Defender
entries: Difficult terrain composed of nonmagical plants doesn't cost the vila extra movement, and it can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard. In addition, while in forested terrain, the vila has advantage on initiative rolls.

trait.name: Poisoned Weapons
entries: The vila's weapons are coated with a magical poison harvest from the forest. When the vila hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d6} poison damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: The vila can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vila can use its Song of the Forest. It then makes two Shortsword or Shortbow attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Song of the Forest
entries: The vila sings one of the following songs at up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target that can hear the song must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or suffer the song's effect.

items.name: Ancient Lullaby
entries: Each creature that fails the saving throw falls {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. The {@condition unconscious} creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

items.name: Fascinating Melody
entries: Each creature that fails the saving throw is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Luckless Tune
entries: Each creature that fails the saving throw has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Denizens of the Wilds (1/Day)
entries: The vila magically calls {@dice 1d4} wolves or 1 wampus cat. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the vila and obeying its spoken commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour, until the vila dies, or until the vila dismisses them as a bonus action.

resist.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered or made of cold iron

trait.name: Close-in Slasher
entries: The vile barber has advantage on attack rolls against any creature in the same space with it.

trait.name: Inhumanly Quick
entries: The vile barber can take two bonus actions on its turn, instead of one. Each bonus action must be different; it can't use the same bonus action twice in a single turn.

trait.name: Invasive
entries: The vile barber can enter, move through, or even remain in a hostile creature's space regardless of the creature's size, without penalty.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: As a bonus action, the vile barber can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Pilfer
entries: As a bonus action, the vile barber can take the Use an Object action or make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.

trait.name: Shadow Step
entries: As a bonus action, the vile barber magically teleports from an area of dim light or darkness it currently occupies, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 80 feet to any other area of dim light or darkness it can see. The barber then has advantage on the first melee attack it makes before the end of the turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vile barber makes two attacks with its straight razor.

action.name: Straight Razor
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Unclean Cut
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that is {@condition grappled} by the vile barber, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. The creature and all its allies who see this attack must make successful {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throws or become {@condition frightened} for {@dice 1d4} rounds.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The vile barber has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vile barber makes two Straight Razor attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or lose 3 {@dice 1d6} hp at the start of each of its turns due to a bleeding wound. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

action.name: Straight Razor
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vile barber can steal one item the target is wearing or carrying, provided the item weighs no more than 10 pounds, isn't a weapon, and isn't wrapped around or firmly attached to the target, such as a shirt or armor.

action.name: Frightening Cut {@recharge 5}
entries: The vile barber makes one Straight Razor attack against a creature it can see within 5 feet of it. If the attack hits and deals damage, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and each creature that can see the attack within 15 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Hidden Step
entries: The vile barber magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see and takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the xiphus is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the xiphus instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the xiphus is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hp equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Siphon Time {@recharge 5}
entries: As a bonus action, a xiphus chooses one creature it can see. The xiphus' clockwork heart vibrates rapidly, bending time to give the xiphus the upper hand against its chosen target. The xiphus chooses whether to have advantage on its attacks against that target or on saving throws against spells cast by the target until the start of the xiphus' next turn.

trait.name: Startling Speed
entries: The movements of a xiphus are so swift that it is almost {@condition invisible} when in motion. If the xiphus moves at least 10 feet on its turn, attack rolls against it have disadvantage until the start of its next turn unless the xiphus is {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The xiphus makes three hidden dagger attacks.

action.name: Hidden Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage.

reaction.name: Borrowed Time (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If damage is dealt to a xiphus that would kill it, it can attempt to temporarily borrow time from another creature to avoid death. One creature the xiphus can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage, and the xiphus regains hp equal to the damage taken. The target is stable and doesn't die if this effect reduces its hp to 0. After 2 rounds, the xiphus takes necrotic damage, and the target regains hp, equal to the original amount borrowed.

trait.name: Dream Leap
entries: Once on its turn, the yumerai can use half its movement to step magically into the dreams of a sleeping creature within 5 feet of it. It emerges from the dreams of another sleeping creature within 1 mile of the first sleeper, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second sleeper. If there is no other sleeping creature within range when it uses this trait, the yumerai is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yumerai makes two psychic lash attacks.

action.name: Psychic Lash
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Somnambulism
entries: The yumerai targets one sleeping creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The yumerai can issue simple commands to the creature, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature takes damage, receives a suicidal command, is told to move into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, or is {@condition grappled} while carrying out the order, it can make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw, awakening and ending the yumerai's control on a success. The yumerai can control only one sleeping creature at a time. If it takes control of another, the effect on the previous target ends.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The yumerai's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The ala doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Poison Flesh
entries: The ala's poison infuses its flesh. A creature that makes a successful bite attack against an ala must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw; if it fails, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Storm's Strength
entries: If an electrical storm is raging around an ala and its target, the saving throw against Lightning's Kiss is made with disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ala makes two claw attacks or one claw and one bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Lightning's Kiss {@recharge 5}
entries: One target within 50 feet must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. It takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The ala doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Poisonous Flesh
entries: The ala's poison infuses its flesh. A creature that touches the ala or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Storm's Strength
entries: If the ala is outside and an electrical storm is within 1 mile of it, creatures have disadvantage on their saving throws against the ala's Lightning's Kiss.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ala makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Lightning's Kiss {@recharge 5}
entries: The ala launches a bolt of lightning at up to three targets it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The Toad King can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Anuran Passivism
entries: No frogs or toads can willingly attack the Toad King. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Feint
entries: As a bonus action before taking an action to attack, the Toad King can attempt to feint an opponent within 5 feet of him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw, or the Toad King has advantage on his next attack.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Toad King has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Toad King's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If he dies, the Toad King's soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In {@dice 1d6} days, it inhabits the body of another frog or toad on the Material Plane, which then becomes the Toad King (with all of the hp and abilities thereof). Only killing every frog and toad on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Royal Croak
entries: As a bonus action, the Toad King croaks at a frog or toad within 30 feet of him. If the target can hear him, it can make one weapon attack as a reaction against any creature that has attacked the Toad King since the end of his previous turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The Toad King can use his action to polymorph into a Large emerald frog, a Medium male human, or back into his true Medium bipedal toad form. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form—with the exception that only his true and frog forms retain his swimming speed. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying transforms with him. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

trait.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
entries: The Toad King can communicate with frogs and toads as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The Toad King's long jump is up to 20 feet and his high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: In frog form, the Toad King makes two bite attacks. In humanoid form, he makes three rapier attacks. In his true form, he makes three attacks: one with his bite and two with his rapier.

action.name: Bite (Frog Form and True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, the Toad King can automatically hit the target with his bite, and he can't make bite attacks against other targets. When the Toad King moves, any Medium or smaller target he is grappling moves with him.

action.name: Rapier (Human and True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry (Human and True Form Only)
entries: The Toad King adds 4 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, the Toad King must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Toad King's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Fire Controller
entries: As a bonus action, the ashen custodian can create or extinguish a nonmagical fire in a 5-foot cube within 30 feet of her, or she can expand an existing fire within 30 feet of her by 5 feet in one direction. If she creates or expands a fire, the target location must have suitable fuel for the fire, such as paper or wood. If the ashen custodian targets a {@creature fire elemental} with this trait, the {@creature fire elemental} has advantage (expanded) or disadvantage (extinguished) on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Forest Cleanser
entries: When the ashen custodian hits a plant or plant creature with her Cleansing Strike, the target takes an extra {@damage 2d8} fire damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ashen custodian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Warming Presence
entries: When a hostile creature starts its turn within 10 feet of the ashen custodian, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage. When a friendly creature within 10 feet of the ashen custodian regains hp, the creature regains an extra {@dice 1d6} hp.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ashen custodian makes two cleansing strike attacks.

action.name: Cleansing Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ashen custodian's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}). The ashen custodian can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Bird Passivism
entries: No bird or ravenfolk can willingly attack the Queen. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The Queen of Birds doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when she flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the Queen of Birds fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Queen of Birds has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If she dies, the Queen of Birds' soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In {@dice 1d6} days, it inhabits the body of another bird on the Material Plane which becomes the Queen of Birds with all of the hp and abilities thereof. Only killing every bird on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The Queen of Birds can use her action to polymorph into a Large jewel-toned eagle, a Medium long-haired elven woman, or back into her true Large, winged humanoid form. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form with the exception that only her true and eagle forms retain her flying speed. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her.

trait.name: Speak with Birds
entries: The Queen of Birds can communicate with birds as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Storm Strike Weapons
entries: The Queen of Birds' weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with a weapon attack, the attack deals an extra {@damage 2d8} damage of her choice of lightning or thunder damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: In eagle or humanoid form, the Queen of Birds makes two attacks. In her true form, she makes three attacks. one with her talons and two with her spear.

action.name: Storm Spear (Humanoid or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 100/300 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning or thunder damage, or 15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning or thunder damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If the Queen of Birds throws her storm spear, it magically reforms in her hand immediately after the attack.

action.name: Talons (Eagle or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d4 + 6}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning or thunder damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, the Queen of Birds can automatically hit the target with her talons, and she can't make talons attacks against other targets. When the Queen of Birds moves, any Medium or smaller target she is grappling moves with her.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The Queen of Birds adds 5 to her AC against one melee weapon attack that would hit her. To do so, the Queen of Birds must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

legendary.name: Soar (Eagle or True Form Only)
entries: The Queen of Birds flies up to her flying speed.

legendary.name: Storm Spear (Humanoid or True Form Only)
entries: The Queen of Birds makes a storm spear attack.

legendary.name: Swooping Death (Costs 2 Actions; Eagle or True Form Only)
entries: The Queen of Birds makes an attack with her talons. If the attack htis, she can fly up to half her speed.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The queen of birds's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

trait.name: Cat Passivism
entries: No cats or weretigers can willingly attack the Queen of Cats. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The Queen of Cats has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Queen of Cats fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Queen of Cats has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Queen of Cats' weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the Queen of Cats moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If she dies, the Queen of Cats' soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In {@dice 1d6} days, it inhabits the body of another cat on the Material Plane which becomes the Queen of Cats with all of the hp and abilities thereof. Only killing every cat on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Safe Fall
entries: When she falls, the Queen of Cats lands on her feet and takes no damage.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The Queen of Cats can use her action to polymorph into a Medium human woman, a Small cat, or back into her true Large, cat-headed humanoid form. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form with the exception that only her cat and true forms retain her climbing speed. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her.

trait.name: Speak with Felines
entries: The Queen of Cats can communicate with cats as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: In human form, the Queen of Cats makes two moon strike attacks. In cat form or her true form, she makes three attacks. two with her claws or moon strike and one with her bite.

action.name: Bite (Cat or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw (Cat or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Moon Strike
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) radiant damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or shed dim light in a 5-foot radius until the start of the Queen's next turn. As long as it glows, the target gains no benefit from being {@condition invisible}, can't hide, and the next attack made against the target has advantage.

legendary.name: Leap
entries: The Queen of Cats moves up to her speed, jumping or climbing over obstacles in the way. Difficult terrain caused by urban or forested terrain features doesn't cost her extra movement when she leaps.

legendary.name: Swipe (Cat or True Form Only)
entries: The Queen of Cats makes a claw attack.

legendary.name: Scurry (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Queen of Cats moves up to her speed and can Hide.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The queen of cats's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 19}). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

trait.name: Arachnid Passivism
entries: No scorpion or spider can willingly attack the Queen of Scorpions. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Queen of Scorpions fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Queen of Scorpions has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Queen of Scorpions' weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If she dies, the Queen of Scorpions' soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In {@dice 1d6} days, it inhabits the body of another scorpion on the Material Plane, which then becomes the Queen of Scorpions (with all of the hp and abilities thereof). Only killing every scorpion on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The Queen of Scorpions can use her action to polymorph into a Huge giant scorpion, a Medium human woman of unearthly beauty, or back into her true Medium, scorpion-tailed humanoid form. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form—with the exception that only her scorpion and true forms retain her climbing and burrowing speeds. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

trait.name: Speak with Arachnids
entries: The Queen of Scorpions can communicate with scorpions and spiders as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The Queen of Scorpions' can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: In human form, the Queen of Scorpions makes two scimitar attacks. In scorpion form, she makes three attacks: two with her claws and one with her sting. In her true form, she makes three attacks: one with her sting and two with her scimitar.

action.name: Claw (Scorpion Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). While in scorpion form, the Queen has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Scimitar (Humanoid or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Sting (Scorpion or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Acidic Bile {@recharge 5}
entries: The Queen of Scorpions spews acid from her mouth in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) acid damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. A {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: At Will Spell
entries: The Queen of Scorpions casts one of her at will spells.

legendary.name: Burrow (Scorpion or True Form Only)
entries: The Queen of Scorpions moves up to her burrowing speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack|phb|opportunity attacks}.

legendary.name: Scimitar (Costs 2 Actions; Humanoid or True Form Only)
entries: The Queen of Scorpions makes one scimitar attack.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Queen of Scorpions' innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Bestowal of Trust
entries: The Queen of Serpents can grant a single creature a +1 enhancement to Wisdom which lasts until the creature harms a reptile of any kind. Only one creature may have this enhancement at any time.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The Queen of Serpents has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Queen of Serpents fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Queen of Serpents has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Queen of Serpents' weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If she dies, the Queen of Serpents' soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In {@dice 1d6} days, it inhabits the body of another serpent on the Material Plane which becomes the Queen of Serpents, with all of the hp and abilities thereof. Only killing every serpent on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Serpent Passivism
entries: No serpents can willingly attack the Queen of Serpents. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Speak with Serpents
entries: The Queen of Serpents can communicate with serpents as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The Queen of Serpents can use her action to polymorph into a Large {@creature constrictor snake}, a Medium human woman of middle age, or back into her true human-snake hybrid form. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form with the exception that only her snake and true forms retain her climbing and swimming speeds. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: In human form, the Queen of Serpents makes three shortsword attacks. In her true form, she makes two attacks. one with her bite and one with her shortsword.

action.name: Bite (Snake or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d6 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Shortsword (Human or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict (Snake or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the creature is {@condition restrained}, and the Queen of Serpents can't constrict another target.

action.name: Mesmerizing Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: The Queen of Serpents targets up to six creatures that she can see within 60 feet of her. Each creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition stunned} for 10 minutes. The target is no longer {@condition stunned} if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the Queen of Serpents' Mesmerizing Gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The Queen of Serpents makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Queen of Serpents moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Precognition (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Queen of Serpents gets a brief glimpse of the immediate future, gaining advantage on attack rolls and Dexterity-based saving throws until the end of her next turn.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The queen of serpents's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 18}). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Elephantine Passivism
entries: No elephant, mammoth, or other elephantine creature can willingly attack the Queen of Mammoths. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Queen of Mammoths fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Queen of Mammoths has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The Queen of Mammoths's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If she dies, the Queen of Mammoths's soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In {@dice 1d6} days, it inhabits the body of another elephantine creature on the Material Plane, which becomes the Queen of Mammoths with all of the hp and abilities thereof. Only killing every elephantine creature on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

trait.name: Speak with Elephantines
entries: The Queen of Mammoths can communicate with any elephant, mammoth, or other elephantine creature as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the Queen of Mammoths moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the queen can make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Queen of Mammoths makes three Battleaxe attacks or two Gore attacks, or she makes one Gore attack and one Stomp attack. She can replace one attack with one Trunk attack or Trunk Slam.

action.name: Battleaxe (Humanoid or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) slashing damage, or 23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Gore (Elephantine or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}34 ({@damage 6d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp (Elephantine or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}34 ({@damage 5d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Trunk (Elephantine or True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the queen can't use her Trunk attack on another target.

action.name: Trunk Slam
entries: One Large or smaller object held or creature {@condition grappled} by the Queen of Mammoths is slammed into the ground or flung away. A creature slammed to the ground must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 5d10}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This doesn't end the {@condition grappled} condition on the target.

A creature flung away is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked {@condition prone}. If a thrown creature strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tusk Sweep (Elephantine or True Form Only) {@recharge 5}
entries: The Queen of Mammoths channels raw magic as she sweeps her tusks in a wide arc. Each creature in a 15-foot cube must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from the queen. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed away.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The Queen of Mammoths transforms into a Gargantuan {@creature oliphaunt|CCodex}, a Huge mammoth, a Medium female human with thick brown hair tied back in a braid, or back into her true Huge elephant-headed humanoid form. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her.

reaction.name: Catch Weapon (Elephantine or True Form Only)
entries: When the Queen of Mammoths is hit by a melee weapon attack, she can reduce the damage by {@dice 1d10 + 17}. If this reduces the damage to 0, the queen can catch the weapon with her trunk if she is not using it to grapple a creature.

If the Queen of Mammoths catches a weapon in this way, she must make a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check contested by the attacker's Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check (the target chooses the ability to use). The queen has disadvantage on the check if the wielder is holding the item with two or more hands.
If she wins, she disarms the creature and can throw the weapon up to 60 feet in a random direction as part of the same reaction.

legendary.name: Regenerative Hide
entries: The Queen of Mammoths regains 15 hp. She can't use this legendary action again until the end of her next turn.

legendary.name: Trunk
entries: The Queen of Mammoths makes one Trunk attack.

legendary.name: Shoving Stampede (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Queen of Mammoths charges, becoming an unstoppable stampede in a line up to 80 feet long and 15 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked {@condition prone}. The Queen of Mammoths's movement along this line doesn't provoke {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

legendary.name: Queen's Trumpet (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Queen of Mammoths raises her trunk and emits a loud trumpeting that is audible out to 300 feet. She chooses up to three creatures that can hear the trumpeting. If a target is friendly, it has advantage on its next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. If a target is hostile, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: One with the Earth
entries: The abbanith giant can detect the flows and rhythms of the earth—including things that interfere with these rhythms, such as earthquakes and magical anomalies. As a result, the abbanith giant can't be surprised by an opponent that is touching the ground. In addition, the giant has advantage on attack rolls against constructs and elementals made of earth or stone.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The giant deals double damage to objects and structures and triple damage to objects and structures made of earth or stone.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abbanith giant makes two thumb claw attacks.

action.name: Thumb Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Earth Counter {@recharge 6}
entries: When a creature the abbanith can see within 30 feet of it casts a spell, the abbanith counters it. This reaction works like the {@spell counterspell} spell, except the abbanith can only counter spells that directly affect or create earth or stone, such as {@spell stone shape}, {@spell wall of stone}, or {@spell move earth}, and it doesn't need to make a spellcasting ability check, regardless of the spell's level.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Laestrigonian giant makes one greatclub attack and one bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or contract a disease. Until the disease is cured, the target can't regain hp except by magical means, and the target's hp maximum decreases by 3 ({@dice 1d6}) every 24 hours. If the target's hp maximum drops to 0 as a result of this disease, the target dies.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Ethereal Jaunt
entries: As a bonus action, the phase giant can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying shifts with it. A creature grappled by the phase giant doesn't shift with it, and the grapple ends if the phase giant shifts while grappling a creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks with its spiked fists. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller target, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage as the giant impales the target on its body spikes.

action.name: Spiked Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). The phase giant has two fists, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit +8} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Snow Camouflage
entries: The snow giant has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

trait.name: Snow Regeneration
entries: The snow giant regains 5 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp and it is in snowy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The snow giant makes two club attacks.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 3d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Giant Snowball
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit +7} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity save or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The priestess has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The priestess's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Protect the Hearth
entries: When the priestess is hit by a weapon attack, up to two friendly creatures within 60 feet of her that can see her can use their reactions to move up to their speed toward the hearth priestess.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hearth priestess uses Hearth Blessing, then makes two Runic Staff attacks.

action.name: Runic Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Hearth Blessing
entries: The hearth priestess calls upon her deity and connection with the hearth to enhance her allies. The priestess empowers one friendly creature she can see within 30 feet of her with one of the following options until the start of her next turn.

items.name: Hearth's Burn.
items.entry: The target's weapon ignites, and when the target hits with the weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

items.name: Hearth's Comfort.
items.entry: If the target is {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, the condition immediately ends. In addition, the target gains 5 ({@damage 1d10}) temporary hp.

items.name: Hearth's Protection.
items.entry: The target's Armor Class increases by 2, and its armor is immune to spells and effects that target or affect the armor, such as the {@spell heat metal} spell or a {@creature rust monster||rust monster's} antennae.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hearth priestess casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Devouring Charge (Boar Form Only)
entries: If the rainforest ogre moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Tusk attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the ogre can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The rainforest ogre has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put the ogre to sleep.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: The rainforest ogre can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rainforest ogre makes two Spear or Tusk attacks and one Bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage, and the ogre gains 5 ({@damage 2d4}) temporary hp.

action.name: Spear (Ogre Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Tusk (Boar Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The rainforest ogre transforms into a Large boar or back into its true form, which is an ogre. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Stone Chomper
entries: The rockchewer ogre deals double damage to stone objects and structures with its bite attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rockchewer ogre makes two Slam attacks or one Bite attack and one Slam attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Chew Rock
entries: The rockchewer ogre thoroughly crushes a rock in its large maw, reducing it to rubble.

action.name: Gravel Spray
entries: The rockchewer ogre spits out a 15-foot cone of crunched up rock. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a successful one. The rockchewer ogre can use this action only if it has used Chew Rock within the past minute.

bonus.name: Quick Chew {@recharge 6}
entries: The rockchewer ogre uses Chew Rock.

reaction.name: Rock Catching
entries: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the rockchewer ogre, the ogre can, with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The ogre has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the ogre reduces a creature to 0 hp with a melee attack on its turn, the ogre can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make one bite attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tusked crimson ogre makes two attacks. one with its morningstar and one with its bite.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Berserker's Blood {@recharge 5}
entries: If the tusked crimson ogre doesn't have all of its hp, it flexes and roars, spraying blood from its wounds. Each creature within 15 feet of the ogre must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage and goes berserk. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't go berserk. On each of its turns, a berserk creature must attack the nearest creature it can see, eschewing ranged or magical attacks in favor of melee attacks. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the berserk creature attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once a creature goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is {@condition unconscious}, regains all of its hp, or is cured through {@spell lesser restoration} or similar magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zimwi makes one claws attack and one bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by the zimwi, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zimwi, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the zimwi's turns. If the zimwi's stomach takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the zimwi must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 5 feet of the zimwi. Damage done to a zimwi's stomach does not harm the zimwi. The zimwi's stomach is larger on the inside than the outside. It can have two Medium creatures or four Small or smaller creatures swallowed at one time. If the zimwi dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the zimwi isn't already grappling a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 11}).

trait.name: Desperate Hunger
entries: When the zimwi is below half its hp maximum, it has advantage on melee attack rolls against creatures that aren't Constructs.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zimwi makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The zimwi has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The zimwi makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the zimwi, and it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the zimwi's turns. A zimwi can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time.

If the zimwi takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the zimwi must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 5 feet of the zimwi. If the zimwi dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Armored Berserker
entries: The pain caused by the iron plates bolted to the abaasy's body keep it on the edge of madness. Whenever the abaasy starts its turn with 60 hp or fewer, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 6, the abaasy goes berserk. While berserk, the abaasy has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

On each of its turns while berserk, the abaasy attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the abaasy attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the abaasy goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hp.

trait.name: Dual Shields
entries: The abaasy carries two {@item shield|phb|shields}, which together give it a +3 bonus to its AC (included in its AC).

trait.name: Poor Depth Perception
entries: The abaasy has disadvantage on attack rolls against a target more than 30 feet away from it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abaasy makes three melee attacks, only one of which can be a Shield Shove attack. If the abaasy uses two hands to make a Spear attack, it can't make an Iron Axe attack that turn.

action.name: Iron Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shield Shove
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 4d4 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} or pushed up to 15 feet away from the abaasy (the abaasy's choice).

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) piercing damage, or 18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Eyebeam {@recharge 5}
entries: The abaasy fires a beam of oscillating energy from its eye in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 5d10}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Healing Lotuscraft
entries: (1/Day). The belu can spend 1 minute crafting a poultice that lasts 24 hours. When a creature takes an action to apply the poultice to a wound or the skin of a creature, the target regains 18 ({@damage 4d8}) hp and is cured of any diseases or conditions affecting it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The belu makes three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed 10 a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the belu and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Shatterstone {@recharge 5}
entries: The belu hurls an enchanted rock at a point it can see within 60 feet of it. The rock shatters on impact, and each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 ({@damage 8d10}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The belu magically transforms into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. If the belu dies, it reverts to its true form.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The belu casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The berberoka can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Aqueous Regeneration
entries: If the berberoka starts its turn in contact with a body of water large enough to submerge at least half of its body, it regains 10 hp if it has at least 1 hit point.

trait.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries: The berberoka has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in marshland or swamp terrain.

trait.name: Swamp Stalker
entries: The berberoka leaves behind no tracks or other traces of its passage when it moves through marshland or swamp terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The berberoka makes three Slam attacks or two Muck-Coated Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Muck-Coated Slam (Saturated Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or its speed is reduced by 10 feet as mud and muck coat the target. A creature, including the target, can take an action to clean off the mud and muck.

action.name: Water Jet (Saturated Only) {@recharge 4}
entries: The berberoka releases all absorbed water as a powerful jet in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 40 ({@damage 9d8}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from the berberoka and knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked {@condition prone}. After using Water Jet, the berberoka is no longer saturated.

bonus.name: Saturated Expansion
entries: While in contact with a body of water, the berberoka absorbs water that is a cube up to 10 feet on a side, and it becomes saturated as the water fills its body. While saturated, the berberoka increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, becoming Huge, and it has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. If the berberoka lacks the room to become Huge, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available. Ground exposed by the absorbed water becomes difficult terrain.

trait.name: Feybane
entries: Creatures of the fey type don't recover spells during a long rest while within 60 feet of the chuhaister. In addition, the chuhaister automatically sees through magical illusions created by spells of 3rd level or lower and has advantage on saving throws and ability checks to detect or see through illusion spells of 4th level or higher.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the chuhaister has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chuhaister makes two greatclub attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 5d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 2} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 5d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Deadfall Shield {@recharge 5}
entries: When the chuhaister or one ally within 30 feet of it is hit by an attack, the chuhaister can create a magical, wooden barrier that interrupts the attack. The attack causes no damage. The shield splinters and disappears afterwards.

trait.name: Final Breath
entries: When the cacus giant dies, it exhales a final breath of divine essence in a gout of intense fire. Each creature within 5 feet of it must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cacus giant makes two greatclub attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 4}
entries: The cacus giant exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Sunlight Petrification
entries: If the giant starts its turn in sunlight, it takes 20 radiant damage. While in sunlight, it moves at half speed and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. If the giant is reduced to 0 hp while in sunlight, it is {@condition petrified}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes three attacks. two with its handaxe and one with its tusks.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tusks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d6 + 8}) slashing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Sand Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

trait.name: Wasteland Stride
entries: The giant ignores difficult terrain caused by sand, gravel, or rocks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two falchion attacks.

action.name: Falchion
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 6d4 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Desert Walk
entries: Difficult terrain composed of sand or gravel doesn't cost the desert giant extra movement.

trait.name: Sand Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two Falchion attacks.

action.name: Falchion
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 6d4 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The firestorm giant makes two Obsidian Axe or Firestorm Bolt attacks.

action.name: Obsidian Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Firestorm Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) fire damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Lava Geyser {@recharge 5}
entries: The firestorm giant gestures at a point on the ground it can see within 60 feet of it. A fountain of molten rock erupts from that point in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. The area is difficult terrain for 1 minute. Each creature in the cylinder must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 24 ({@damage 7d6}) fire damage and is coated in hardened lava. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't coated in hardened lava. A creature coated in hardened lava has its speed halved while it remains coated. A creature, including the coated creature, can take its action to break and remove the hardened lava, ending the effect.

trait.name: Ancestral Spirits
entries: Three ghostly spirits haunt the giant. The spirits are incorporeal, remain within 10 feet of the giant at all times, and can't take actions. Each uses the giant's AC and saving throws, has 15 hp and can only be harmed by radiant damage. If an ancestral spirit is reduced to 0 hp, it disappears temporarily. Reduce the giant's AC by 1 and remove one trait granted by the spirits for each spirit that is driven off. Ancestral spirits can't be turned.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the giant can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn. This trait is granted by the ancestral spirits.

trait.name: See Invisibility
entries: The giant can see {@condition invisible} creatures and objects as if they were visible and can see into the Ethereal Plane. This trait is granted by the ancestral spirits.

trait.name: Steadfast
entries: The giant is immune to the {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened} conditions. This trait is granted by the ancestral spirits.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Death Malison
entries: When the hellfire giant dies, the runes on its body flash a bright green then turn to mundane malachite. Each creature within 20 feet of the giant must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be cursed for 7 days or until it is lifted by a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic. While cursed, the creature has disadvantage on saving throws and on the first attack roll it makes on each of its turns. Fiends have disadvantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Rune-Powered Weapons
entries: The hellfire giant's weapon attacks are magical. When the giant hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d8} fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two Greatclub or Runic Blast attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Runic Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d10 + 3}) force damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. Fiends have disadvantage on the saving throw.

action.name: Invisibility Rune
entries: The hellfire giant magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the giant wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

reaction.name: Runic Shield
entries: The hellfire giant adds 4 to its AC against one attack that would hit it as green runes encircle the giant. To do so, the giant must see the attacker and can't be {@condition invisible}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes three Pitchfork attacks, or it makes one Pitchfork attack then uses Grab and Throw. Alternatively, it can make one pitchfork attack then use Grab and Throw.

action.name: Pitchfork
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60/240 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Grab
entries: The shire giant reaches out and grabs a Medium or smaller creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) by the giant. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Throw
entries: The shire giant throws a creature it is grappling at a space it can see within 30 feet of it. The thrown creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or land {@condition prone}. If the target space is occupied by another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Contortionist
entries: The thin giant can contort its body into unnatural positions, allowing it to easily move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature. It can squeeze through any opening large enough for a Small creature. The giant's destination must still have suitable room to accommodate its volume.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thin giant makes three melee attacks, but it can use its Consuming Bite only once.

action.name: Consuming Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the giant regains hp equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +10} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Forged Forgery
entries: Thursir armorers wear armor that has been forged from dwarven armor and shaped to resemble dwarven armor. Skilled blacksmiths can recognize and exploit this design quirk. When a creature proficient with smith's tools scores a critical hit against the thursir armorer, the armorer's armor breaks, reducing the armorer's Armor Class by 5 until the thursir armorer repairs the armor. If the thursir armorer is critically hit by any creature while its armor is broken, its armor shatters and is destroyed, reducing the armorer's Armor Class to 12.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thursir armorer uses Flinging Smash, if available. It then makes two Battleaxe attacks or one Battleaxe attack and one Shield Bash attack.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage, or 16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Flinging Smash {@recharge 5}
entries: The armorer makes a sweeping strike with its shield. Each creature within 10 feet of the armorer must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the armorer and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Runic Armor (3/Day)
entries: The armorer can inscribe the thurs rune on its armor. When a creature hits the armorer with a melee weapon attack while the rune is active, the creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage and can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. The rune lasts for 1 minute.

bonus.name: Harness Dwarven Soul
entries: The thursir armorer draws on the soul fragment trapped in one of the dwarven skulls on its belt. The armorer has advantage on ability checks when using smith's tools and on attack rolls using a battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, or warhammer until the start of its next turn. The armorer carries six skulls on its belt.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The ogre has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Tentacle Senses
entries: The Void-blessed ogre can't use its {@sense tremorsense} while {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Void-blessed ogre makes one Tentacle Lash attack and one Void Bite attack, or it makes three Void Spit attacks.

action.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn, as jumbled visions and voices of the Void fill its mind.

action.name: Void Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Void Spit
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Volatile Stomach
entries: When the Void-blessed ogre takes bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, it can regurgitate some of its stomach contents. Each creature within 5 feet of the ogre must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. A pool of Voidinfused stomach contents forms in a space the ogre can see within 5 feet of it and lasts until the start of the ogre's next turn. A creature that enters the pool for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The degenerate titan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The degenerate titan makes two greatclub attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Earthstrike {@recharge 4}
entries: The degenerate titan slams his fists onto the ground, creating a shockwave in a line 60 feet long and 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) force damage and is flung up 20 feet away from the titan and knocked {@condition prone}; a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw halves the damage and prevents the creature from being flung or knocked {@condition prone}. A creature that's flung against an unyielding object such as a wall or floor takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If it collides with another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage ({@dice 1d6} bludgeoning per 10 feet) and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Shout of the Void {@recharge 4}
entries: The degenerate titan utters a scream that rends reality in a 30-foot cone. Any ongoing spell or magical effect of 3rd level or lower in the area ends. For every spell or effect of 4th level or higher in the area, the degenerate titan makes a Constitution check against DC (10 + the level of the spell or effect). On a success, the spell or effect ends.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The degenerate titan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The degenerate titan can use its Reality‑Bending Shout. It then makes three Greatclub attacks or two Rock attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Reality-Bending Shout
entries: The degenerate titan utters a scream that vibrates the fabric of reality around one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The titan can attempt to end one magical effect of its choice of 3rd level or lower on the target. This effect works like the {@spell dispel magic} spell, except the titan must always make an ability check. The titan's ability check for this is +4.

action.name: Earthstrike {@recharge 5}
entries: The degenerate titan slams its fists onto the ground, creating a shockwave in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) force damage and is flung 20 feet away from the titan and knocked {@condition prone}, as the earth buckles and tosses the creature. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't flung or knocked {@condition prone}. If a flung creature strikes a solid surface, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was flung. If the creature is flung at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The lantern giant can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid {@quickref suffocating||2}.

trait.name: Hypnotic Luminescence
entries: The tendril on the lantern giant's head sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet. When a creature that can see the light starts its turn within 60 feet of the giant, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or become {@condition charmed} for 24 hours, regarding the giant as a friendly acquaintance. If the giant or one of its allies harms the {@condition charmed} creature, this effect ends. If the creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the giant's Hypnotic Luminescence for the next 24 hours. At the start of its turn, the lantern giant chooses whether this light is active.

trait.name: Speak with Aquatic Creatures
entries: The lantern giant can communicate with Beasts and Monstrosities that have a swimming speed as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lantern giant makes three Trident attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Trident
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft. one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 8}) piercing damage, or 21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Crush of the Deep {@recharge 5}
entries: The lantern giant subverts the environment to summon the pressure of the deepest ocean depths in a 40-foot cube of water centered on a point it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature in the cube must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw as the pressure increases, taking 44 ({@damage 8d10}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lantern giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Blacklight Strobe
entries: The visual flicker of the shadow giant moving between the Material Plane and the Shadow Realm has a physical effect on viewers.
