A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the shadow giant and that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be unable make more than one melee or ranged attack on its turn and unable to use bonus actions or reactions until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Distracting Flicker
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the shadow giant and that is maintaining concentration on a spell must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or lose concentration.

trait.name: Shadow Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the shadow giant's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Umbral Glimmer
entries: At the end of each of the shadow giant's turns, it must roll a {@dice d20}. On a roll of 11 or higher, it enters the Plane of Shadow from the Material Plane. At the start of its next turn, it returns to the Material Plane in an unoccupied space of its choice that it can see within 40 feet of the space where it vanished. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, it appears in the nearest unoccupied space.
While in the Plane of Shadow, the shadow giant can see and hear 120 feet into the Material Plane. It can't affect or be affected by anything on the Material Plane while in the Plane of Shadow.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow giant makes three attacks with its tenebrous talons.

action.name: Tenebrous Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Cold Shadow {@recharge 5}
entries: The shadow giant directs its shadow to stretch out in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 52 ({@damage 15d6}) cold damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't have disadvantage.

trait.name: Indomitable
entries: Any spell or effect that would make the xing tian {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition restrained}, or {@condition stunned} ends at the end of the xing tian's next turn, regardless of the spell or effect's normal duration.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The xing tian has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The xing tian makes three attacks: one with its shield slam and two with its battleaxe. If both battleaxe attacks hit the same target, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) piercing damage as the xing tian bites the target.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shield Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Dance of the Unyielding
entries: The xing tian stomps and waves its arms in a martial dance, and it regains 10 hp. Until the dance ends, the xing tian regains 10 hp at the start of each of its turns and melee attack rolls against the xing tian have disadvantage. It must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue dancing. It can stop dancing at any time. The dance ends if the xing tian is {@condition incapacitated}.

walk.condition: (20 ft. fly 120 ft. in roc form)

trait.name: Keen Sight (Roc Form Only)
entries: Hraesvelgr has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Influence Weather
entries: Nearby weather responds to Hraesvelgr's desires. At the start of each minute, Hraesvelgr can choose to change the precipitation and wind within 3 miles of him by one stage, up or down (no action required). This effect works like the changing weather conditions aspect of the {@spell control weather} spell, except Hraesvelgr can't change the temperature and the conditions change immediately.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Hraesvelgr fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hraesvelgr makes one Beak attack and two Talon attacks, or he makes three Fist attacks. Alternatively, he can make three Gale Blast attacks. If two Fist attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Beak (Roc Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Fist (Giant Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Talons (Roc Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. Hraesvelgr has two talons, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Gale Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Swallow (Roc Form Only)
entries: Hraesvelgr makes one Beak attack against a Large or smaller creature he is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside Hraesvelgr, and it takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) acid damage at the start of each of Hraesvelgr's turns. Hraesvelgr can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If Hraesvelgr takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, Hraesvelgr must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of Hraesvelgr. Hraesvelgr has disadvantage on this saving throw if he isn't in his roc form. If Hraesvelgr dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by him and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Sudden Gust {@recharge 5}
entries: Hraesvelgr unleashes a powerful gust of wind in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 63 ({@damage 18d6}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from Hraesvelgr. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: Hraesvelgr transforms into a roc or back into his true form, which is a Giant. His statistics, other than his speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Hraesvelgr makes a Fist or Talons attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Hraesvelgr moves up to his speed, or flies up to half his flying speed if in roc form, without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Ear-Splitting Screech (Costs 2 Actions; Roc Form Only)
entries: Hraesvelgr lets out an ear-splitting screech. Each creature within 30 feet of Hraesvelgr must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) thunder damage and be {@condition deafened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the mountain giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: A mountain giant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mountain Master
entries: The mountain giant can move and shape the terrain around it. This trait works like the move earth spell, except it has no duration, and the giant can manipulate any stone, natural or worked.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The mountain giant deals triple damage to objects and structures with its melee and ranged weapon attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mountain giant makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d12 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Boulder
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 15} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}40 ({@damage 5d12 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Boulder Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The mountain giant unleashes a barrage of boulders in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 58 ({@damage 9d12}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained}. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone} or {@condition restrained}. A target, including the {@condition restrained} creature can take an action to make a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, freeing the {@condition restrained} creature on a success.

legendary.name: Grasping Soil
entries: The mountain giant commands the earth itself to assist in the fight. The giant chooses three creatures it can see within 60 feet. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The mountain giant emits a tremendous growl. Each creature within 20 feet of the giant must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) thunder damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Spawn Elemental (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: rA piece of the mountain giant's body tears away in the form of an earth elemental. The earth elemental acts on the same initiative count as the mountain giant, obeying the mountain giant's commands and fighting until destroyed. The mountain giant can have no more than five earth elementals under its control at one time.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Absorb Potion
entries: The ooze can absorb any potion, oil, tincture, or alchemical draught that touches it, choosing to be affected by the substance or to nullify it.

trait.name: Perishable
entries: These oozes don't fare well in sunlight and don't easily endure the rigors of travel. The creature dies if it is directly exposed to sunlight for more than 1 minute. Each day it is more than 1 mile from its "birth" place, the ooze must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or die.

trait.name: Produce Potion (1/Day)
entries: The alchemical apprentice can produce one common potion, oil, tincture, or alchemical draught each day. If no creature is there to bottle, or otherwise collect, the substance when it is produced, it trickles away and is wasted.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d8 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Magical Burble
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid, cold, fire, or poison damage.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Arboreal Movement
entries: The ooze can move through trees as if they were difficult terrain. Creatures preserved inside of it are expelled into unoccupied spaces within 5 feet of the tree when the amber ooze moves in this way. The amber ooze can end its turn inside a tree, but it is expelled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the tree if the tree is destroyed.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The amber ooze uses its Engulf. It then makes two pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod.
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a plant or plant creature, it also takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the ooze enters the creature's space and the creature is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained}, and, after {@dice 1d4} rounds, the creature is {@condition petrified}. A creature {@condition petrified} by the ooze remains {@condition petrified} until 24 hours after it exits the ooze. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.

An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

trait.name: Corrupting Touch
entries: When a corrupting ooze scores a critical hit or starts its turn with a foe {@condition grappled}, it can dissolve one leather, metal, or wood item of its choosing in the possession of the target creature. A mundane item is destroyed automatically; a magical item is destroyed if its owner fails to make a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw.

trait.name: Strong Swimmer
entries: A corrupting ooze naturally floats on the surface of water. It swims with a pulsating motion that propels it faster than walking speed.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The ooze doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Putrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the corrupting ooze must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The corrupting ooze makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or one nonmagical leather, metal, or wooden item the creature is wearing or carrying is destroyed. This effect can't destroy armor or weapons.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

bonus.name: Reshape Body
entries: The corrupting ooze can reshape its mass into a vaguely Humanoid shape or back into its amorphous shape. It reverts to its amorphous shape if it dies. While in a Humanoid shape, it can take any action that requires hands, except it can't wield weapons or a shield or don armor.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The eldritch ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Maddening Form.
entries: When a creature with an Intelligence of 3 or higher that can see the eldritch ooze starts its turn within 30 feet of the ooze, the ooze can force it to make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw if the ooze isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. If the creature fails, it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage and is {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its turn.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the eldritch ooze until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the ooze in the meantime, it must immediately make the saving throw.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The eldritch ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Void-Infused Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or its Intelligence score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces its Intelligence to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When an eldritch ooze that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new oozes if it has at least 10 hp. Each new ooze has hp equal to half the original ooze's, rounded down. New oozes are one size smaller than the original ooze.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ooze has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sense Destroyer
entries: The ichor ooze knows the direction and distance to the creature that performed the killing blow on the fiend that created the ooze, as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Hurl Mote
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit +4} to hit, range 10/30 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) fire damage.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: One creature grappled by the ooze must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the ooze regains hp equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ink guardian can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Bottled Rejuvenation
entries: When activated, the creature launches from its bottle, landing within 20 feet of the bottle. It starts as Tiny, and at the start of each of its turns, it increases in size by one step to a maximum of Large.

When the ink guardian is defeated, the bottle becomes inactive for {@dice 3d8} hours. After that time, the ink guardian regains all its hp and is active again. The bottle has AC of 20, 10 hp, and is immune to damage that isn't bludgeoning. If the bottle is destroyed, the ink guardian dies and can't rejuvenate.

trait.name: Selectively Caustic
entries: A creature that touches the ink guardian or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage. The ink guardian can eat through flesh quickly, but it doesn't harm metal, wood, or paper.

trait.name: Volatile
entries: When the ink guardian is subjected to thunder damage, it takes no damage and instead splashes onto creatures within 5 feet of it. Each creature in the area takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage. When the ink guardian is reduced to 0 hp, it explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: As a Medium or Large creature, the ink guardian makes two pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The leavesrot ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the leavesrot ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary pile of leaves.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The leavesrot ooze doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Rotting Leaves
entries: When a creature hits the leavesrot ooze with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, mold spores and decomposing matter fly out from the wound. Each creature within 5 feet of the ooze must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) acid damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, the ooze can automatically hit the target with its Pseudopod, and the ooze can't make Pseudopod attacks against other targets.

action.name: Release Spores {@recharge 5}
entries: The leavesrot ooze releases spores from the mold coating its leaves. Each creature within 20 feet of the ooze must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and is choking. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't choking. A choking creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Eye-Watering Stench
entries: The manure ooze gives off an odor so pungent it can bring tears to the eyes. A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the ooze must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If a manure ooze takes fire damage, it bursts into flame until the end of its next turn. When it hits with a Pseudopod attack while on fire, the Pseudopod deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The manure ooze doesn't require sleep.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Digest Corpse
entries: The manure ooze dissolves a corpse in its space that is less than 1 week old. It regains {@dice 1d6} hp per size category of the creature it consumes. For example, it regains {@dice 1d6} hp when consuming a Tiny creature or {@dice 4d6} hp when consuming a Large creature. The corpse is then destroyed, and this action can't be used on it again.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a manure ooze that is Medium or larger is subjected to slashing damage, it splits into two new oozes if it has at least 10 hp. Each new ooze has hp equal to half the original ooze's rounded down. New oozes are one size smaller than the original ooze.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an oily pool or wet rock.

trait.name: Mineralize
entries: As a bonus action when it has encased a creature, the ooze hardens the minerals in its body, turning the surface of its body into a stone-like material. While mineralized, the ooze has a walking speed of 5 feet, and it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. The ooze remains mineralized until the creature it has encased dies, or until the ooze takes a bonus action to end it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mineral ooze makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}), and the ooze uses its Encase on the target.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Encase
entries: The mineral ooze encases a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. The encased target is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the ooze's turns or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage. If the ooze moves, the encased target moves with it. The ooze can have only one creature encased at a time. An encased creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 12} Strength check. The creature has disadvantage on this check if the ooze is mineralized. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze. Alternatively, a creature within 5 feet of the ooze can take an action to pull a creature out of the ooze. Doing so requires a successful {@dc 12} Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage. The creature making the attempt has disadvantage on the check if the ooze is mineralized.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Aura of Darkness
entries: The ooze devours all natural and magical light within 30 feet of it. This area is heavily obscured by darkness for all creatures except shadow fey.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes one pseudopod attack and then uses Snuff Out.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Snuff Out
entries: The ooze extinguishes one natural or magical light source within 60 feet of it. If the light source is created by a spell, it is dispelled.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Hollow Cylindrical Form (Stretched Body Only)
entries: Creatures can occupy the space in the center of the cylinder formed by the sinkhole ooze, and each such space is always within the ooze's reach, regardless of the size of the cylinder.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The sinkhole ooze doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Seizing Pseudopods
entries: The sinkhole ooze can have up to six tendril-like Pseudopods at a time. Each Pseudopod can be attacked (AC 10; 10 hp; immunity to acid, poison, and psychic damage). Destroying a Pseudopod deals no damage to the ooze, which can extrude a replacement Pseudopod on its next turn. A Pseudopod can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Strength check against it.

trait.name: Slimy Appearance (Stretched Body Only)
entries: While the sinkhole ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from the interior of the pit or hole in the ground it is stretched across, though the interior walls appear to be wet.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The sinkhole ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sinkhole ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage at the start of each of its turns, and the ooze can't use the same Pseudopod on another target.

bonus.name: Stretch Body
entries: The sinkhole ooze stretches its body around the inner walls of a pit, sinkhole, or other circular opening in the ground. When stretched in this way, the ooze forms a hollow cylinder that is up to 25 feet tall with an up to 25-foot radius. The ooze can end the stretch as a bonus action, occupying the nearest unoccupied space to the hole in the ground.

reaction.name: Pluck (Stretched Body Only)
entries: When at least one creature falls down the center of the cylinder formed by the sinkhole ooze, the ooze can try to grab up to two of the creatures. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) in one of the ooze's Pseudopods.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Seeping Death
entries: A living creature that touches the ooze or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or contract a disease. At the end of each long rest, the diseased creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or its Dexterity score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest after the disease is cured. If the disease reduces the creature's Dexterity to 0, the creature dies and its body becomes a suppurating ooze {@dice 1d4} hours later. The disease lasts until removed by the {@spell lesser restoration} spell or other similar magic.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become infected with the seeping death disease (see the Seeping Death trait).

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The voidpool can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The voidpool has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

trait.name: Planar Portal
entries: The voidpool has a portal to the Void at its core. A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the voidpool must make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw. On a success, the creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage but isn't pulled toward the portal. On a failure, the creature takes no damage but is pulled closer to the portal. A creature that fails three saving throws before escaping the grapple enters the portal and is transported to the Void. This transportation works like the banishing an unwilling creature aspect of the {@spell plane shift} spell.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The voidpool can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The voidpool makes two pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the voidpool doesn't have two other creatures {@condition grappled}. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and it risks being pulled into the Void (see the Planar Portal trait).

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The goo can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Deadly to Fey
entries: The goo has advantage on attack rolls against fey and any creature with the Fey Ancestry trait.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The goo can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Yaga goo makes two pseudopod attacks. When its Foul Transit is available, it can use Foul Transit in place of one pseudopod attack.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Foul Transit {@recharge 4}
entries: The goo teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 50 feet, leaving behind a wretched puddle in the space it previously occupied. A creature within 5 feet of the space the goo left must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage and become {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. The first time a creature enters the puddle's space or if a creature starts its turn in the puddle's space it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage and is {@condition poisoned}. The puddle lasts for 1 minute or until the goo that created it is killed.

reaction.name: Puddle Splash
entries: When a creature the Yaga goo can see targets it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of the goo, the goo can teleport to a puddle created by its Foul Transit, if that puddle's space is unoccupied, negating the damage from the attack. If it does, the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage and become {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Flowing Flesh
entries: The animated offal can move through spaces as narrow as 6 inches wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Healing Sense
entries: The animated offal can sense healing spells, effects, and potions within 120 feet of it. If the ooze is the target of a healing spell, if it consumes a healing potion, or if it is affected by a similar magical effect, it gains a +2 bonus to its AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and can use its Pseudopod attack as a bonus action for 1 minute.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The animated offal doesn't require sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The animated offal makes two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the animated offal doesn't have two other creatures {@condition grappled}. If the target is holding or carrying one or more healing potions, there is a {@chance 25} chance one potion shatters during the attack, allowing the animated offal to absorb the healing energy and gain the benefits of its Healing Sense.

bonus.name: Subsume
entries: The animated offal begins absorbing one creature it is grappling. The creature must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The animated offal regains hp equal to half the damage dealt. If the animated offal is at its hp maximum, it gains temporary hp for 1 hour instead. The animated offal can add temporary hp gained from this trait to temporary hp gained earlier from this trait. Its temporary hp can't exceed 48. If its temporary hp would exceed 48, a new animated offal appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the animated offal. The new Ooze is Small, doesn't have this bonus action, and has 10 hp.
A creature killed by this bonus action is fully subsumed into the animated offal and can be restored to life only by means of a {@spell reincarnate} spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The black patch can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Eldritch Luminance
entries: When a creature that can see the black patch starts its turn within 90 feet of the ooze, the black patch can force it to make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw if the ooze isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. On a failure, the creature is mesmerized for 1 minute. A mesmerized creature that is more than 5 feet away from the black patch must move on its turn toward the ooze by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the ooze, the target can repeat the saving throw. A mesmerized target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the black patch's Eldritch Luminance for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Flowing Form
entries: The black patch can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The black patch doesn't require sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The black patch makes two Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Viscid Suffocation.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Viscid Suffocation
entries: One creature in the black patch's space must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage, and the black patch attaches to it, coating the creature and its equipment. While the black patch is attached to it, the creature's speed is halved, it can't breathe, and it takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. In addition, if the creature is in the water, it has disadvantage on ability checks to swim or stay afloat. The black patch can devour flesh quickly, but its acid doesn't harm metal, wood, or other similar objects or creatures without flesh. The black patch can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the black patch by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Strength check.

mechanics.name: Oozasis
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The oozasis can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Mirage
entries: As a bonus action, the oozasis can create a mirage around itself to lure victims toward it while disguising its true nature. This functions as the {@spell mirage arcane} spell (save {@dc 16}) but is nonmagical, and therefore can't be detected using detect magic or similar magic, and can't be dispelled.

trait.name: Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion
entries: Any creature that drinks the water of an oozasis or eats fruit from the plants growing in it has a dream (as the {@spell dream|phb|spell}, save {@dc 16}) the next time it sleeps. In this dream, the oozasis places a compulsion to carry out some activity as a torrent of images and sensations. When the creature awakens, it is affected by a {@spell geas} spell (save {@dc 16}, cast as a 7th-level spell) in addition to the effects of {@spell dream}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oozasis makes two pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage, and a target that's Large or smaller is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) and {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends. The oozasis has two pseudopods, each of which can grapple one target at a time.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The oozasis engulfs creatures {@condition grappled} by it. An engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained}, is no longer {@condition grappled}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the oozasis, takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the oozasis's turns, and is subject to the oozasis's Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion trait. The creature takes no damage if the oozasis chooses not to inflict any. When the oozasis moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. An engulfed creature can escape by using an action and making a successful {@dc 16} Strength check. On a success, the creature enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the oozasis.

action.name: Vapors of Tranquility or Turmoil (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The oozasis sublimates its waters into a vapor that fills a disk centered on the oozasis, 60 feet in radius, and 10 feet thick. All creatures in the area are affected by either the {@spell calm emotions} spell or the {@spell confusion} spell (save {@dc 16}). The oozasis chooses which effect to use, and it must be the same for all creatures.

mechanics.name: Oozasis
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The oozasis can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Oasis Appearance
entries: While the oozasis remains motionless and partially submerged on the surface of sand or soil, it is indistinguishable from a small oasis or pond. The oozasis's body provides enough water for plants to grow around it, provided the oozasis remains in the area for an extended period of time. A creature that eats a fruit from a plant growing in the oozasis's water is affected by the Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion trait as if it drank the water.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The oozasis doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion
entries: A creature that drinks the water of an oozasis experiences a cryptic dream the next time it sleeps. When it wakes, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the {@spell geas} spell for 30 days. While under the geas, the affected creature must perform a specific, seemingly minor task that furthers the decades-long goals of the oozasis. Such a task could be planting a white rose in a specific garden, rescuing the next endangered young animal the target encounters, or standing in a specific spot at a certain time each day for three days.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oozasis makes three Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. The oozasis can have up to two creatures {@condition grappled} at a time.

action.name: Compelling Vapors {@recharge 5}
entries: The oozasis emits mind-altering vapors. Each creature within 20 feet of the oozasis must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) psychic damage and suffers either tranquility or turmoil for minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't suffer tranquility or turmoil. A creature suffering tranquility is {@condition charmed} and can't attack. A creature suffering turmoil is unable to distinguish friend from foe and must move to and attack the nearest creature other than the oozasis on each of its turns, stalking off in a random direction if no creature is in range. A creature suffering tranquility or turmoil can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Blood Drain
entries: A creature that touches the ooze or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage and the ooze gains temporary hp equal to that amount as it drains blood from the victim. It can add temporary hp gained from this trait to temporary hp gained from its pseudopod attack and Overflow reaction. Its temporary hp can't exceed half its maximum hp. If the ooze takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the ooze's next turn, although it retains any temporary hp it previously gained.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage. The ooze gains temporary hp equal to the necrotic damage taken.

reaction.name: Overflow
entries: When the blood ooze is hit with a melee attack, it can drain blood from the attacker. The attacker must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The ooze gains temporary hp equal to the necrotic damage taken.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The ooze has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Lightning Storm
entries: A creature that touches the ooze while wearing metal or hits it with a melee attack with a metal weapon takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage and triggers a lightning storm. All creatures within 20 feet of the ooze that are holding or wearing metal must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The foxfire ooze makes three pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The giant shark bowl can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The giant shark bowl has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

trait.name: Electrical Charge
entries: When the giant shark bowl is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead becomes charged for 1 minute. While charged, its attacks deal an extra 2 ({@damage 1d4}) lightning damage.

trait.name: Ooze Fish Bowl
entries: The shark bowl takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but they are subjected to the bowl's Engulf and have disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the bowl can be seen but have total cover. A creature within 5 feet of the bowl can take an action to pull a creature out. Doing so requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage. The bowl can hold one Large creature or up to six Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

trait.name: Symbiotically Bound
entries: The ooze and the giant shark's life forces have been entwined by an arcane force. They share statistics as if they were one monster and can't be separated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant shark bowl makes two attacks. one with its bite and one with its pseudopod.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The giant shark bowl moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the bowl enters a creature's space, the creature must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the bowl. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

On a failed save, the bowl enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained}, and takes 22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage at the start of each of the bowl's turns. When the bowl moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 15} Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the bowl.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The ooze has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Corrosive Form
entries: A creature that touches the ooze or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the ooze is coated in a corrosive red slime. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the ooze is destroyed after dealing damage. The ooze can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a pile of rubies.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ruby ooze makes two pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Acid Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The ooze sprays its bright red protoplasm in a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage and is {@condition restrained} as its flesh begins to turn into a translucent ruby-like stone. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. The {@condition restrained} creature must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of its next turn, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage and becoming {@condition petrified} on a failure or ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: Until the shoal ooze attacks, it is indistinguishable from a large school of fish.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The shoal ooze doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Symbiotically Bound
entries: The ooze and the fish's life force have become entwined. They share statistics as if they were one creature and can't be separated.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The shoal ooze can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shoal ooze uses Mesmerizing Spiral. It then makes three Pseudopod attacks and uses Engulf.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Engulf
entries: The shoal ooze engulfs one Huge or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. The engulfed target is {@condition restrained} and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water, and it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the ooze's turns or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage. If the ooze moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The ooze can have two Huge creatures or up to eight Large or smaller creatures engulfed at a time.

An engulfed creature, or a creature within 5 feet of the ooze, can take its action to remove the engulfed creature from the ooze by succeeding on a {@dc 16} Strength check, putting the engulfed creature in an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

action.name: Mesmerizing Spiral
entries: The fish inside the shoal ooze swim rapidly in a hypnotic spiral. Each creature within 20 feet of the ooze that can see the fish must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} for 1 minute. While {@condition incapacitated}, its speed is reduced to 0. The {@condition incapacitated} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Mesmerizing Spiral of all shoal oozes for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: The sinoper ooze can shift the paint within its form to appear like any painting or fresco it has touched. While the ooze remains motionless on a flat surface, such as a wall or ceiling, it is indistinguishable from that work of art.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The sinoper ooze doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sinoper ooze makes three Paint Splash attacks.

action.name: Paint Splash
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) acid damage, and the target is coated in paint. Roll a die. On an even roll, the target is coated in a warm color paint, such as red, orange, or yellow. On an odd roll, the target is coated in a cool color paint, such as blue, green, or purple. A creature, including the target, can use its action to remove the paint.

action.name: Foment Pigment {@recharge 4}
entries: The sinoper ooze activates latent magic in its paint, burning or freezing the paint off creatures affected by Paint Splash. Each creature coated in paint within 60 feet of the sinoper ooze must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) cold damage (if coated in a cool color paint) or fire damage (if coated in a warm color paint) and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. Each affected creature is no longer coated in paint.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The snow ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the snow ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a patch of snow.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The snow ooze can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The snow ooze doesn't require sleep.

trait.name: Snow Blindness
entries: When a creature that can see the snow ooze starts its turn within 30 feet of the ooze, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of its next turn. This trait doesn't function while the snow ooze is in dim light or darkness.

trait.name: Snow Burrower
entries: The snow ooze can burrow through nonmagical snow and ice in addition to sand, earth, and mud.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The snow ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage.

action.name: Avalanche {@recharge 4}
entries: The snow ooze rumbles forward, stirring up snow as it goes. The ooze moves up to 30 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, that creature must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw.

On a failure, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage and is buried in slushy snow. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't buried. A buried creature is {@condition restrained} and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature, including the buried creature, can take its action to free the buried creature by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Strength check. A buried creature with a swimming speed has advantage on this check.

trait.name: Fire Hazard
entries: When the ooze takes fire damage, it bursts into flame. The ooze continues burning until it takes cold damage or is immersed in water. A creature that touches the ooze or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it while it is burning takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage. While burning, the ooze's weapon attacks deal an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Sticky Situation
entries: A creature covered in the ooze's tar has its speed halved for 1 minute. In addition, the tar ignites if touched by a source of fire or if a creature covered with tar takes fire damage. The tar burns until a creature takes an action to snuff out the flames. A creature that starts its turn covered with burning tar takes 10 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage. A humanoid that dies while covered in tar rises 1 hour later as {@creature tar ghoul|CCodex} ({@loader Creature Codex|creature/Kobold Press; Creature Codex.json}), unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

action.name: Multiattack.
entries: The tar ooze makes two pseudopod attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target is covered in tar (see Sticky Situation).

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Hurl Tar
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit +2} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be covered in tar (see Sticky Situation).

trait.name: Malleable Physiology
entries: At the start of its turn, the atavist gains one of the following benefits until it ends the effect (no action required) or the start of its next turn: {@sense Darkvision} out to a range of 30 feet.
A climbing, flying, or swimming speed of 30 feet.
Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
Bony spikes sprout along its skin, and a creature that touches the atavist or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The atavist makes two Keratin Blade or Bone Shard attacks. If both attacks hit one target, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage as bits of bone dig deeper into the target.

action.name: Keratin Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bone Shard
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Frenzy (1/rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the bearfolk can trigger a berserk frenzy that lasts 1 minute. While in frenzy, it gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and has advantage on attack rolls. Attack rolls made against a frenzied bearfolk have advantage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bearfolk has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bearfolk makes three attacks: one with its battleaxe, one with its warhammer, and one with its bite.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used two-handed.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage if used two-handed.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bearfolk has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bearfolk makes one Battleaxe attack, one Warhammer attack, and one Bite attack.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

bonus.name: Frenzy (Recharges after a Long or Short Rest)
entries: The bearfolk triggers a berserk frenzy that lasts 1 minute. While in frenzy, it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and has advantage on attack rolls. Attack rolls made against a frenzied bearfolk have advantage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortspear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge}
entries: The behtu exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area takes 21 ({@damage 5d8}) fire damage, or half damage with a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw.

action.name: Ichorous Infusions
entries: Behtu war parties carry {@dice 1d6} vials of ichorous infusions. They often ingest an infusion before an ambush. For the next {@dice 2d6} rounds, the behtus gain a +4 bonus to their Strength and Constitution scores and quadruple their base speed (including their climb speed). Behtus also take a −4 penalty to their Intelligence and Wisdom scores for the duration of the infusion. A non-behtu character who ingests a behtu infusion becomes {@condition poisoned} and takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage; a successful {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw against poison reduces damage to half and negates the {@condition poisoned} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The behtu makes one Bite attack and one Spear attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge}
entries: The behtu exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Ichorous Infusion
entries: The behtu ingests an infusion made from Mechuiti's blood. For 1 minute, the behtu has advantage on saving throws and ability checks that use Strength and Constitution, and its walking and climbing speeds are doubled. In addition, it has disadvantage on saving throws and ability checks that use Intelligence and Wisdom for the duration. A non-behtu that ingests the infusion must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. The behtu typically has {@dice 1d4 + 1} infusions in its possession.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the black knight commander is mounted and moves at least 30 feet in a straight line toward a target and then hits it with a melee attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 ({@dice 3d6}) damage.

trait.name: Hateful Aura
entries: The black knight commander and allies within 10 feet of the commander add its Charisma modifier to weapon damage rolls (included in damage below).

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The black knight commander's weapon attacks are made with magical (+1) weapons.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The black knight commander makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Frightful Charge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The black knight commander lets loose a terrifying cry and makes one melee attack at the end of a charge. Whether the attack hits or misses, all enemies within 15 feet of the target and aware of the black knight commander's presence must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Hateful Presence
entries: Each friendly creature within 10 feet of the black knight commander gains a +2 bonus on weapon damage rolls but can't use the Help action.

trait.name: Locked Saddle
entries: The black knight commander can't be knocked {@condition prone}, dismounted, or moved against its will while mounted.

trait.name: Mounted Charge
entries: If the black knight commander moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature while mounted and then hits it with a Lance attack on the same turn, the commander can use a bonus action to command its mount to make one melee weapon attack against that creature as a reaction.

trait.name: Mounted Warrior
entries: The black knight commander is rarely seen without its warhorse mount. The warhorse wears custom barding that raises is Armor Class to 15, and mounting and dismounting the warhorse costs the commander only 5 feet of movement. While the commander is mounted, its mount can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The black knight commander makes one Lance attack and two Mace attacks. If the commander is mounted, its mount can then make one Hooves attack. If both Mace attacks hit one creature, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Charge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: While mounted, the black knight commander lets loose a terrifying cry. It then moves up to 30 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, that creature must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't {@condition frightened}. A {@condition frightened} creature can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Tactical Insight
entries: The city watch captain has advantage on initiative rolls. City watch soldiers under the captain's command take their turns on the same initiative count as the captain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The city watch captain makes two rapier attacks and one dagger attack. The captain can substitute a disarming attack for one rapier attack.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Disarming Attack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}the target must make a successful {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or drop one item it's holding of the city watch captain's choice. The item lands up to 10 feet from the target, in a spot selected by the captain.

action.name: Orders to Attack (1/Day)
entries: Each creature of the city watch captain's choice that is within 30 feet of it and can hear it makes one melee or ranged weapon attack as a reaction.

trait.name: Point Blank Fencer
entries: A rapier deals one extra die of its damage when the city watch captain hits with it (included in the attack). In addition, the captain ignores the loading property of crossbows and doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll with a crossbow from being within 5 feet of a hostile creature. The captain may still have disadvantage on such an attack from other sources.

trait.name: Tactical Insight
entries: The city watch captain has advantage on initiative rolls, and friendly creatures within 30 feet of the captain and under the captain's command can choose to take the captain's initiative instead of their own when combat starts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The city watch captain can use its Issue Orders. It then makes two Rapier attacks or three Light Crossbow attacks, or it makes one Rapier attack and two Light Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the city watch captain can force the target to drop one weapon it is wielding or drop one item it is carrying. If the captain chooses to make the target drop an item, the item can't be wrapped around or firmly attached to the target, such as a shirt or armor. The item lands in a space of the captain's choice within 5 feet of the target.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Issue Orders
entries: The city watch captain shouts orders at up to two friendly creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target can do one of the following as a reaction:

items.name: Attack
entries: The target makes one weapon attack with advantage.

items.name: Defend
entries: The target gains a +2 bonus to its Armor Class until the start of the captain's next turn.

items.name: Reposition
entries: The target moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Object Reading
entries: By concentrating for 10 minutes on a specific object, a corpse thief learns more about the object's most recent owner. The effects of this trait are different depending on if the most recent owner is alive or dead. This trait only works once per object.

items: If the most recent owner is alive, the corpse thief sees through that person's eyes for 10 minutes. This works like the clairvoyance spell, except the most recent owner is the sensor and controls which direction it is pointed, how far it can see, etc. The most recent owner must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a success, it gets the sensation that it is being watched.

If the most recent owner is dead, the corpse thief can learn five things about the person's life through dream-like visions and emotions. This works like the speak with dead spell, except the spirit can only answer questions about events in which the object was present.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The corpse thief makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Steal
entries: The corpse thief targets one creature within 5 feet of it and attempts to steal one small item. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or lose one non-weapon, non-armor object that is small enough to fit in one hand.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The cueyatl can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Jungle Camouflage
entries: The cueyatl has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in jungle terrain.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The cueyatl moon priest has advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to escape a grapple.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The cueyatl's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Night's Chill {@recharge 5}
entries: The cueyatl moon priest harnesses moonlight, dispelling magical light in a 30-foot radius. In addition, each hostile creature within 30 feet must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) cold damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that has total cover from the moon priest is not affected.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cueyatl moon priest is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). The cueyatl moon priest has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The cueyatl can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Jungle Camouflage
entries: The cueyatl has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in jungle terrain.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The cueyatl has advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to escape a grapple.

trait.name: Speak with Sea Life
entries: The cueyatl sea priest can communicate with amphibious and water breathing beasts and monstrosities as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The cueyatl's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Trident
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, or 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cueyatl sea priest is a 2nd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). The cueyatl sea priest has the following druid spells prepared:

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The cueyatl can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Jungle Camouflage
entries: The cueyatl has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in jungle terrain.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The cueyatl has advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to escape a grapple.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The cueyatl's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage if used with two hands.

trait.name: Gliding Wings
entries: The tosculi drone can use its wings to slowly descend when falling (as if under the effect of the feather fall spell). It can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every foot it falls. The tosculi drone can't gain height with these wings alone. If subjected to a strong wind or lift of any kind, it can use the updraft to glide farther.

trait.name: Skittering
entries: Up to two tosculi can share the same space at one time. The tosculi has advantage on melee attack rolls while sharing its space with another tosculi that isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Crowd Tactics
entries: The tosculi can share its space with up to one other tosculi. While sharing its space with one other tosculi, it has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if the other tosculi in its space isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Glide
entries: The tosculi can extend its vestigial wings while falling to slow its rate of descent to 60 feet per round, landing on its feet and taking no falling damage. It can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it falls. The tosculi can't gain height with its wings alone. If subjected to a strong wind or lift of any kind, it can use the updraft to glide farther.

trait.name: Hive Sense
entries: The tosculi can pinpoint the location of its hive queen when she is within 300 feet of it, and it can sense the general direction and distance to the hive where its queen makes her home.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Deadly Precision
entries: The tosculi elite bow raider's ranged attacks do an extra 9 ({@dice 2d8}) damage (included below).

trait.name: Evasive
entries: Ranged weapon attacks against the tosculi elite bow raider have disadvantage.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The tosculi elite bow raider has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Skirmisher
entries: The tosculi elite bow raider can Dash as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tosculi elite bow raider makes two longbow attacks or two claws attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Archer
entries: A ranged weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the tosculi hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Hive Sense
entries: The tosculi can pinpoint the location of its hive queen when she is within 300 feet of it, and it can sense the general direction and distance to the hive where its queen makes her home.

trait.name: Point Blank Hunter
entries: When the tosculi makes a ranged attack with a bow, it doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll from being within 5 feet of a hostile creature, though it may still have disadvantage from other sources.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tosculi elite bow raider makes two Claw or Longbow attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d4 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Skirmisher
entries: The tosculi takes the Dash or Disengage action.

trait.name: Pheromones
entries: The jeweled drone emits a sweet scent that empowers other tosculi within 15 feet of the drone. A tosculi that starts its turn within the area can add a {@dice d6} to one attack roll or saving throw it makes before the start of its next turn, provided it can smell the scent.
